reviews.text:
I’ve been taking my dogs to the Throw Me a Bone location at Silver Towers for years and have always had a good experience, so I decided to try this location for the first time. Unfortunately, I won’t be returning.

When I made the appointment, I specifically requested sanitary trims for both dogs and was assured they were complimentary and included. I also requested de-shedding for only ONE of my two dogs.

After the grooming was completed and my dogs had already been sent back, the groomer messaged me with the final cost and asked about the tip. After I agreed to 15%, I was told they had de-shedded BOTH dogs, despite my requesting it for only one, and had not done the sanitary trim on either dog.

The groomer explained that my requests hadn’t been communicated to him by reception and suggested speaking directly to the groomer in the future so details don’t get lost. That’s fine—but I should have been told this when booking instead of being assured that my requests were taken care of.

When I expressed my frustration, I was told the manager would be informed and would follow up with me directly. Several days passed and nobody contacted me. That was the final nail in the coffin.

There was an opportunity to address the issue when I was an unhappy customer and specifically expecting a follow-up. Contacting me only after a public review would make it feel like the priority is the review rather than the customer experience.
Daycare, Boarding, Grooming. This company has it all!!

Amazing service!  They groomed my dog amazingly and she always looks so cute afterwards.  They also take amazing care of my dog and immediately let me know when she's done so she doesn't have to wait too long.

Amper enjoyed her four day weekend stay. She met new friends and was beyond exhausted after I got her back due to playing nonstop.  She got her exercise for sure.  I love the constant photos and the report card is the best.  Thank you for making her welcome as a New Yorker dog ❤️🐾 the only thing that disappoints is the extra charge for staying during the day even if she already boarded plus additional weekend fees.
Thank you Eugenia! We appreciate you and are glad you're happy with the experience!

The facilities and staff put us at ease and we can be assured Percy will be well cared for when we travel. They provide frequent daily photos of him at rest and play, as well as reports on his eating and activities. Percy seems very happy and we trust in the services they provide.

I hate leaving negative reviews, but because this place has such high ratings, I wanted to share our experience.

First, the facility is located in a basement, which requires walking down nearly three flights of stairs. We had to carry our long-haired dachshund because the stairs weren’t manageable for him. The space was extremely hot and small.

During check-in, the groomer assumed we wanted our long-haired dachshund shaved. We had to clarify twice that we did not want him shaved. So if you go here, you should make it super clear what kind of cut you want. Also long hair dachshund shouldn’t be shaved so that raised some concerns for us.

Another thing that made us uncomfortable was seeing our dog picked up by his front legs/armpits. Dachshunds are especially prone to back issues, so seeing him handled that way was concerning.

When we picked him up, he seemed okay, and the groom itself was fine, although it looked a bit uneven in places, and it seemed like only some of his nails had been trimmed.

Overall, while our dog was okay, we will not be returning.
Customer service was great and they did a good job grooming Princess

My puppy, Ripple,  had her first day at Throw Me A Bone. And she loved it! The staff was incredible and the space is great. Special thing - we received photos of our puppy regularly throughout the day. Made the experience extraordinary.
Very attentive. And very well adjusting to my dogs needs. There are many people in the playground attentive all the dogs, giving love and holding them and all.

Our dog was quite nervous at the start of her stay, but the staff at Throw Me A Bone was exceptionally patient and welcoming. We specifically appreciated the regular photo updates they sent throughout the day, which provided reassurance regarding her well-being. By the time we arrived for pickup, she appeared both happy and relaxed. The team’s professional approach to handling anxious pets and their consistent communication made for a very positive experience. Highly recommended for pet owners seeking attentive care.

Luis did a great job trimming our doggy nails, even if she hates it !!
Thanks for your work

Fast and easy booking and grooming experience with very convenient neighborhood location, clear building directions to get to the business suite, and friendly, professional, and comforting service for my rescue's first nail trim!
Did a great job with my Wheaten Terrier. He looks great.
Rao always does an amazing job of grooming my labradoodle. Thank you!!
Charlie was in great hands at this location! Staff is extremely friendly, and loved that we could check-in and see how Charlie was doing via the dog cameras! Great spot for daycare.

Love this place!!! Would not trust our 15 year Mini Cooper with anyone else. They always make sure he is comfortable, give him extra attention when needed and provide daily updates on how he is doing! The staff is amazing!!!
Thank you Scott! We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!
The best grooming shop in the area! Even though Toro hates baths  he absolutely loves coming here!The team here is professional, kind I can always tell Toro feels safe and happy.Thank you
The service is impecable.   My dog is always being taken care at their different locations
Olaf enjoyed his first time there- looking forward to going back!
Staff is always extremely kind and helpful! Our dog loves coming to daycare here.
This is the only daycare I use in the city! they are great and I love that they keep me update throughout the day. It's an added bonuses that some of their locations are also open at the weekends.

We just started going for Doggy Daycare and we love it! The staff are all super friendly and helpful, explained the enrollment process and helped set up the app. Our dog is anxious in new surroundings and they totally picked up on that and helped her through her big feelings!

Isabella is a great groomer. The staff in general are terrific, they love the dogs. LOVE the video feed when my dog is at day care. Would prefer small/big dog separation- but the dog minders manage to keep
It OK. A great safe place for your dog!
Isabella has been grooming my cairn terrier for over 2 years. She keeps her coat long yet tamed with scissors and my pup loves coming in to see her!
My cavalier king charles spaniel loved his haircut - was looking all shaggy and then came back lookin' like he quit drinking. Super cute, well groomed, and happy when I got him back.

Taking my Yorkie for the first time to throw me a bone. Rio was his groomer and once I got him back I was in love with the way Rio groomed my dog looked very handsome. Will take Coco again to Throw me a bone.
A great daycare with a friendly and thoughtful staff. My dog loves going to TMAB!

My pet dog, Leo, went to day care at the 52nd street location and had a blast! The staff was very communicative and sent me photo updates of Leo making friends, enjoying an outdoor walk, and napping. He can’t wait to be back!

We couldn’t be happier with TMAB. From the moment we walked in 2018/2019, the staff made Niza and Fira feel welcomed, safe, and genuinely loved. They pay close attention to each dog’s personality and needs, and it really shows. The facility is clean, well organized, and full of enrichment activities that keep the dogs engaged. I also appreciate the regular updates, the doggy webcams, and the way the team goes above and beyond to make sure every pup is comfortable. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a place where their dog will be treated like family.
Thank you Felicia! We appreciate you and are glad you're happy with the experience!

The team at TMAB 52nd street are amazing.
Oliver loves going to daycare and has made so many friends over the years. Thank you for taking care of him!

So annoying, i made clear and sure that the groomer understood to not cut the cost short, and guess? She been almost shaved without call me first, asking or whatever and the way my dog been shaved it’s ridiculous	“My dog’s coat was cut unevenly, with long and short patches for a total of 217$ !!!

Our French Bulldog Lola loves her daycare at Throw me a Bone.  She literally can't wait to get there!  We have been very impressed with the attention and care given to the dogs, as well as the friendly and professional staff always there to greet Lola.
Highly recommended!

Our frenchie, Elton, is absolutely obsessed with Throw Me a Bone. The moment we tell him he’s going to daycare, he runs to the front door, pulls us down the hall and gently head butts the elevator until he’s there. He’s always so excited to see his “teachers” and they are always so engaged with him. At home, we joke that we can travel and he’s mildly excited when he comes home; after 24 hours away from TMAB, he’s losing his mind with joy when he sees Gio or Alina or James. Elton is a high energy pup and TMAB staff keeps him constantly entertained with toys and enrichment activities. Not to mention the fact that they’ve helped us throw two iconic birthday parties for our baby guy. We love TMAB and cannot recommend it enough!

Rio was amazing and gave my 5 month old puppy the best luxury bath - he looks more adorable than ever and didn’t want to leave!! Thank you Rio for your gentle expertise and to Throw Me a Bone for making the process so easy and convenient! We are so lucky you are just an elevator away!
Hands down the best doggy daycare! The staff is loving, attentive and communicative. Our puppy is always excited to go. We are so grateful to have found such a trustworthy daycare in NYC.

Throw me a bone has been the best for our dog Dexter! Moving to a new city is huge transition for a 10 year old pet and the team at Throw Me A Bone has made Dexter feel at home when he is there for the day. We love getting the updates through out the day through pictures. Being able to check on him through the web cam is a huge perk as well. So grateful we were able to found a place that takes so much care of baby boy!
TMAB is Lincoln’s home away from home. I never feel stressed when at work or traveling because I know the TMAB crew takes such great care of him. Highly recommend!
They seem to really care about the pups and the website is easy to navigate! Mickey is recognized on the street by the sweethearts who take care of him.
My mom was very, very impressed with Isabella on her dog.  She was disappointed on groomers in other places. So, I am so happy she is very satisfied with Mochi!'s hair cut from Isabella.

I absolutely love this place. I’ve been looking for a great place for my dog Daisy for grooming, daycare and occasional boarding. The staff is fantastic and they stay in touch during the day and send pictures of my dog and others. This place is the best.

Daisy had her first day at Throw Me A  Bone and they’ve sent me pictures and updates and she’s having a great time. Yesterday she got groomed there and came came home very happy and beautiful. I’m so grateful I found this place in my neighborhood and I expect that Daisy is going to spend time there every week.
TMAB did a great job with my mixed breed ‘don’t touch my front paws!’ 10 yr old!  On time, quick, and the groomer kept  my Murphy calm the entire time.   I will be back!

We don’t trust many people with Brownie, so choosing a daycare was a big deal for us. What stood out immediately with Throw Me A Bone wasn’t just how kind they were, but how careful they were. They didn’t just take our money and put him in a room. They took the time to really evaluate him, his personality, his energy, and whether the environment was actually a good fit for him. That meant a lot. It told us they care just as much about the dogs as the owners do. From that first interaction on, we felt comfortable and confident leaving Brownie there. He’s happy when he goes, relaxed when he comes home, and we never have that uneasy feeling you get when something doesn’t sit right.
Trust is everything, and Throw Me A Bone earned ours.
Everyone is friendly and cares about the dogs they take care of!
My dog and I are fans of Throw Me A Bone! They really came through for us, cared for him well and we were very pleased. Professional, accommodative , and kind.
My baby looks amazing and the staff was beyond sweet and kind.
My dog Henry enjoyed his day at Throw Me A Bone. Everyone was very communicative and I am happy with how his daycare stay went!
Love how they care for and make my labradoodle look amazing every time I bring him in! Highly recommended groomer.
I am amazed by the great customer service received by throw me a bone and mainly Rio, they really care for your pet and are very communicative. Thanks guys
Thank you Joseph! We appreciate you and are glad you're happy with the experience!
A fantastic experience. My little Annie was so happy after she got some good playtime with the gang. We’ll be back.

The team at Throw Me a Bone were awesome! They took my Chihuahua Kiko with a quick enrollment call and as a walk-in during the busy weekend schedule. Gio did a great job and hooked Kiko up with a little tie. These guys are great so go and check them out soon. Thanks!

Isabella was great and did such a good job with Taco's bath. He is super anxious and he was ok when we came to pick him up. We also had a comms snafu with TMAB and they corrected it and as someone who works in client-facing roles I really appreciated the quick response and will certainly come back with Taco for his grooming. Thanks, everyone!

Best dog daycare in NYC.

- Dogs are in an indoor open area all day, with at least one person in the room at all times.

- Dogs are walked. (Which I think is included)

- Crates on premises to be used during feeding times when necessary or needed.

- Took the time to chat about my dog before dropping her for an evaluation and ask if she has allergies to any treats they like to give out.

- Gives updates throughout the day on their app include photos and notes.

- Live cameras on their app so you can watch your dog.

I go out of my way to drop my dog off here when I’m in the city for work and need a place for her to spend the day.
Thank you Clara! We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!
They take really good care of my baby!! Always 5/5.
Incredible service and they did an amazing job with Maybelle! Were even courteous enough to hold her a few extra hours while I was at work. Will be back!
They do a great job

They cancelled our puppy’s (Louie) grooming appointment twice and remade it to another day without confirming with us. I guess it was convenient for them. I get it if you have to cancel because groomer did not show up to work but the deposit should be returned.
We already paid half of the fee for the deposit. Crazy how a business changes your appointment time without confirming and they make you forfeit your deposit when you dont make it to the appointment.
Our pup loves it here! As a new customer it was very easy to onboard and the staff was so nice and caring with our doggo!

All the groomers here at throw me a bone are extremely talented. I a provided pictures of my dog Randy right after previous haircuts and he literally came home looking exactly like the photos. Soooo cute and clean!
Always a great experience! Very personal and the cutest haircut for my dog.

This was the first time I left Chanel on Throw Me A Bone, and I was extremely impressed. The location is great, and the entire team is wonderful — they were super attentive and caring with Chanel from the very beginning.

Their safety and care system really stand out. Besides having cameras that we can access every day, they also send photos of the dogs during their walks and keep us updated about feeding and any other care details. This made me feel very at ease while she was staying there.

I loved the whole experience, and this Boarding School is definitely my number one choice from now on. Chanel loved it, and so did I! 🐶💛
Facilities are cleaned. Staff is friendly. Fast communication via the application and email. Keep you updated about your pet with photos.

My dog Milli is a very active, exuberant 40lb ball of pure muscle that can be pretty overwhelming but TMAB was able to care for her with no problem.  I explained how she gets excited about certain things and that it can be difficult to handle her if you're not used to handling a Staffordshire Bull Terrier but they assured me they're re experienced with all types of dogs and let me know these types of dogs are often misunderstood which alleviated any concerns I had that she would overwhelm them.

I picked Milli up at the end of the day and she actually sat next to the door on the way out like she wanted to stay there longer!

Isabella is a phenomenal groomer who very obviously cares for the animals she works with — I have a very fluffy, double-coated dog, and she worked tirelessly to remove his stubborn blown undercoat. It was clearly exhausting work, but she did not cut any corners purely for my dog’s comfort. I’m incredibly grateful.

We moved our dog here after a great year at Pupculture on 57th Street — zero issues there. We decided to try Throw Me a Bone simply because it’s closer to home. About a month in, they contacted us saying our dog showed “dominance behavior” and “resource guarding,” which came as a surprise given his spotless history at his previous daycare.

Shortly after, they sent us a training price list and told us our dog couldn’t return until we signed up for their training program. It felt less like genuine behavioral concern and more like a sales tactic.

Also worth noting — the facility is in the basement of an apartment building. It’s very small, windowless, and feels quite suffocating compared to other daycares we’ve seen.

Isabella was an amazing groomer for my dog, Cheese! She was kind, patient and very attentive to her needs (especially as Cheese has an old injury that makes one of her paws sensitive). She also gave Cheese the best groom she has ever gotten — exactly what we were looking for! We’re excited to come back next time.

We took our 5 month old puppy for her first groom at Throw Me A Bone and couldn’t be happier! I was running late and Isabella was super understanding. She made our puppy feel comfortable right away, and also gave her a great haircut, with exactly the specifications we asked for! We will definitely be back.

My dog loves his days at Throw Me a Bone (W 52nd Street)! From the moment he knows where he's headed, he pulls my leash towards the door and runs inside as soon as they greet us. The management and team is wonderful and I go about my day assured that my pup is taken great care of. The hours are extremely accommodating and they pay attention to the notes I leave regarding his snacks. I love that the dogs are taken for walks as part of full day care & I can keep up with him through live feed video and photos throughout the day. I can't recommend this place enough!

Our one year-old dog, Remi, had a great experience getting her wash and cut here! She is a little anxious but Isabella worked well with her and she ended up coming out looking beautiful and happy! We definitely plan to bring her here again!
Took my pup in for daycare evaluation. The staff are super friendly and professional! Already reserved my pup's boarding in future. Highly recommend!!

After going in person & speaking with Isabella G., I booked our first appointment, for an elderly friend’s 14 year old Cocker Spaniel, Princess who live across the 52nd. St. location.  She was so kind, so patient & so helpful with answering my questions. The first grooming with Isabella was the absolute best. She is highly skilled, pays attention to the little details that matter so much. She was also very gentle with her treatment of my friend & her dog
(so important).  Second grooming was yesterday & again, she did an impeccable job!  Very grateful to have given this place a try & very grateful for finding Isabella! Looking forward to our next appointment with her in 2 months. 🙏🏼🥰👍🏼💫💜

Isabella did an amazing job grooming my dog Randy! 🐾 His haircut looks exactly like the reference photo I showed her, and he came out looking so clean, sharp, and adorable. She was also so sweet and gentle with him the entire time, which means a lot. The results are honestly perfect—his coat looks fresh, and the style suits him so well. I’m so impressed and definitely plan to come back. Highly recommend Isabella if you want your pup looking their absolute best!
Thank you Alex! We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!

A friend in the neighborhood pointed me to Throw Me a Bone for doggie day care during a business trip to NYC. I appreciate the courteous and responsive customer service, as well as the team's commitment to providing a good experience for all the doggies under their care – and for keeping me updated throughout the day with cute pics!

Isabella has that magic touch! My golden loves her and gets the best haircut and bath. Amy (my dog) has always been scared of the groomer, but whenever we get close to throw me a bone, she runs down the hallway, cause she can’t wait.
My dog had a great time and the workers are very professional and helpful.
Throw Me A Bone is always great fun for my dog Alexis and also I am confident in the safety and kind demeanor of the staff.
Professional and courteous service! My baby adores Juan!!!

We started bringing our 4 month old puppy here for daycare and have been very impressed so far!! She was a little anxious to warm up but the staff works great with her and helps her work through it! We get lots of updates and photos throughout the day. You can tell they really care about each dog! Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a reliable daycare!

Throw me a bone is hands down one of the best i.e. least stressful boarding / daycare locations in the city -- my dog is always happy to go there (and will try to go there even when just out for a walk), and every time he comes home he's super mellow and super well-behaved to boot.

They provide daily updates, with copious notes, and frequent posts on the stay, so I'm never worried about him when I'm away.
Great service, conveniently located,  very friendly staff.

I was super nervous about having my goldendoodle puppy groomed for the first time since bringing him home, but I felt like he was in such good hands with Isabella! She was so friendly, thoughtful, and communicative and put both me (and, more importantly, my puppy!) at ease. She took the time to check in about what kind of style I was hoping for, and it turned out great. I loved the cute bandana that my pup got after his bath, too! Definitely will be returning here for future grooming appointments.
Juan was amazing!!!
Throw me a bone, treats our senior dog like their own! Champ gets excited to go and be with the people and other dogs.
Great communication by Daniella. My dog was looked after well.

They were incredibly patient with our baby Gino, especially since he gets super anxious without us. They told us that they’ll take an hour for our fur baby to get used to them, and if he didn’t then unfortunately we would have to pick him up, but if that did happen, they wouldn’t even charge us for the hour! Fortunately they were patient with our Gino and he got to stay the day! We love the updates and posts and pictures! Our fur baby can rarely stay still for pictures, but we are so glad they got to take some for us to see! We also love the live camera feature! We’ve had a wonderful experience, and would definitely come back here when we visit NYC again!!! Thank you for loving Gino as much as we do.
Thank you Annalissa! We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!
Best ever!
Prompt, quick and super well done. Definitely have a client for life

We love throw me a bone! Our dog JJ has been getting groomed by Juan for about 2 years now. Juan does an amazing job and JJ always looks so clean and handsome after with a little bandana. JJ has anxiety in general but Juan is very kind and calm and caring with him and JJ does great with his grooming! Everthing runs ontime and the weekend hours are super convenient . Highly  recommend
Very good experience. The dog seemed to enjoy boarding there and they sent me beautiful photos of her during her stay.

Boba has been going to throw me a bone for at least 2 months now. She only goes occasionally (when we can’t work from home) and we really like the care the team provides. They have video access so you can check on your pup whenever you’d like to. They separate dogs with too much energy and not as much. They constantly try to remain a clean environment. They give dogs potty breaks if they stay longer and take photos to send to you. I noted that Boba has resource guarding with toys and they abide by it which I really appreciate. Boba just had her first bath and Isabelle did a great job! They were so kind to watch her for me after the bath so I could finish working before picking her up. It really uses up a lot of her energy and I can just go home and relax with my pup. Just wishing there was more space for the dogs. Appreciate all the hard work Throw Me A Bone Team! Thank you, thank you!
They take SUCH good care of our senior, special needs dog.  Isabella, his groomer, is simply the best.  She's kind, patient, and I can't recommend her enough.  Throw Me a Bone deserves your business!

My dog can have pretty bad separation anxiety when I am not around, so it can be stressful for me dropping her off for boarding. They always put my mind at ease here and make my dog feel very comfortable. When I drop her off they are always so welcoming and happy to see her. The constant picture updates and Report Cards allows me to relax and enjoy my vacation knowing she is having fun and is being well taken care of.

My dog loves it here, and I love being able to watch him on the camera. Easy to book and employees are super friendly.
Nail trims are fairly priced and easy to schedule.

Thanks TMAB!!
It’s very good experience. My Puppy was very happy. I really appreciate Throw Me A Bone. 👍👍

We love Throw Me A Bone, and so does our golden retriever, Hank. The facility is clean and well-maintained. The staff is amazing and friendly. They send you pics of your dog throughout the day. You can also watch the dogos via their webcam. Convenient hours and attentive staff. Easy-to-use app to make reservations and buy packages. We're so happy and highly recommend Throw Me A Bone. Thank you guys!

If I could give zero stars, I would. I’ve never been more unsatisfied with a dog grooming place in my life. I took my dog to Throw Me a Bone for a “specialty cut” that cost over $200, and what I got was a complete joke of a service—actually, it was worse than a joke, it was negligent.

I dropped my dog off and was told the grooming would take a while, so I left. I came back an hour and a half later, only to find out they hadn’t even touched him. My dog had been just sitting there the entire time, and the groomer? He was literally in the back sitting on his phone, not doing a thing.

Then, clearly panicked that I showed up, he rushed to wash, cut, and groom my dog in less than 30 minutes. And the result was exactly what you’d expect from a rushed, sloppy job: my dog had THREE cuts on his skin. The groomer didn’t say a word, didn’t apologize, didn’t even acknowledge what he’d done. Just handed my dog over like nothing happened. The “cut” itself looked uneven, patchy, and completely unprofessional. Honestly, it looked like someone with no training did it.

I’m part of a large dog community and group here in the city, and you can bet I’ll be posting about this experience and recommending that everyone stay far away from this place. They are lazy, unprofessional, sloppy, and they clearly don’t care about the animals they’re trusted to take care of. This place is all branding and zero quality. Do not take your dog here for grooming

My dog Max has been going here for over a year now and we love it. He gets to run around with his friends all day and I know he loves it. He literally runs down the stairs when it’s time to go to daycare in the morning. I also get him groomed here and he always comes home smelling wonderful! I am very grateful for the amazing staff!

Dog is always excited to get there
Always comes home tired and peaceful
Never an issue, have been using them for years. she has stayed as long as several days, and is always happy as can be when I pick her up.

Throw Me A Bone is a great Doggie care service provider. My doggo Disco loves them! They provide a welcoming and interactive environment for doggos. They send lots of photos so when I'm on vaca I can see how he's doing. They also post fun videos of him on Instagram.
5 star service accompanied with excellent communication, knows how to handle my (crazy) pup with professionalism and love - highly recommend for grooming!!

Terrific doggie daycare and boarding! Teddy LOVES going to TMAB. Entire staff is caring and excited to be there. The location is spotless, well run, and they have a live cam/send pix. Highly recommend!
Throw me a bone always takes amazing care of my Dog Yuki. They are reliable & always available when I have last minute requests.

My dogs love TMAB. Every time I say “let’s go to daycare” they get so happy that I can tell for sure they have a good time there. They already did daycare, boarding, grooming and training sessions and I don’t have nothing to complain. I love the fact we have access to the camera and receive multiple pictures during their stay. I have tried other dog daycares but TMAB definitely got my heart.

My pup was extremely well cared for while I was away - he got to stay in his own bed at home, and I got regular updates and lots of pictures of him so I didn’t have to worry about his well-being one bit.

We have been bringing our dog to Throw Me A Bone for a while now and absolutely love it!! The staff are so kind and helpful. Our dog literally pulls me down the steps to go into the facility, which is how I know she loves going. My favorite thing of all is how there are cameras. My dog is like my child so being able to see her having fun during the day and getting so much love from the staff makes me insanely happy and confident that she is in great hands!
Our dog has loved her time at throw me a bone, every day she’s excited to go to daycare and comes home exhausted after
It’s our Aidan boys favorite place! Great cost for AMAZING care!
Juan is our groomer & is experienced, gentle & caring when he grooms my Bichon Madison. I recommend him & this location of Throw Me A Bone without reservation.

We moved to the area and chose this daycare based on a few factors: communication, photos and live feed, and ratio and engagement of staff to dogs. Our dog is a little anxious but is well looked after whenever we drop her off. Highly recommend!

The one thing to mention (as in other reviews) is that the entrance is a little weird to get to, and it would be great to have more clear marking to get there. But, still absolutely worth the experience!

My Cairn terrier Leo just turned five and has been going to TMAB almost one or two times every week since he was one year old.  The staff is great with him, makes sure he has a good time, and meets his needs as well as those of all the other dogs.  I have TMAB to thank for having a well socialized dog.  I have also boarded him there several times sometimes for a whole week and they take great care of him, sending me pictures and updates daily and sometimes even sleeping with him!  This is the only place I would leave my dog in NYC, I can’t recommend it enough.

I can't say enough good things about Throw Me a Bone!

Peace of mind is priceless, and thanks to TMAB, I can confidently focus on my work knowing that my beloved Melo is safe, happy, and well-cared for. I wholeheartedly recommend this daycare to any dog owner looking for a trustworthy and nurturing environment for their canine family members!

I’m a very picky dog-mom to two pups—a carefree two-year-old German Shepherd and a more reserved Black Lab—so handing over the leash is never easy. Throw Me A Bone made it effortless.

From the moment we checked in, the staff greeted us by name and remembered each dog’s quirks: our Shepherd's happy-go-lucky eagerness to meet every new friend, and our Lab's need for a little extra space after some past dog-on-dog scuffles. The team thoughtfully matched them with either high-energy playgroup or a quieter, low-pressure introductions. I even got a midday update that our Lab felt so relaxed she curled up for a nap during daycare—huge progress!

Daily report cards and photo updates landed in my inbox right after playgroup, showing one blissfully tired Shepherd grin and one content, comfy Lab snooze. The facility itself is spotless—no lingering “kennel” smell—and the separate yards by size and play style mean everyone stays safe and happy.

Shout out to Isabella for doing such a great job with my little guy. I was a little apprehensive about trying out a new groomer due to my dogs semi aggressive temperament. I was surprised to see how calm and docile he was under Isabella’s care .
